channel_order: rank order, hottest first. The FFN sum is invariant under any consistent permutation of gate rows / up rows / down columns, so this is free and makes a further prune a pure prefix slice.
exactness_contract: NONE, by construction: the pruned model computes the dense function restricted to the kept channels. It is not an approximation of the dense FFN, it is a smaller FFN. Measured cost on the 9B at keep=3440 with a corpus-wide ranking: 1.859x dense perplexity on one held-out split and 3.011x on another.
scaling: NONE. A pruned SwiGLU FFN is a smaller SwiGLU FFN -- dropping channels drops terms and the survivors keep their own weights. No renormalisation exists to compensate for, unlike the partition converter's xE (and its x(E/k) blowup at smaller top_k) or the hot core's x2 sigmoid(0) correction.
